## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 16.09.2026 - 18.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Arch Cee_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "Still 1 star. Given up hope on this app, its been years and you haven't fixed anything. Can't create meals, anything you add, just get returned to the logging. Changing the navigating menu every year when you've just gotten use to the old one, it benefits no one. Logs me out everytime I enter the app. I'm stopping my next subscription. Fix your damn app and stop charging overpriced subscriptions for an app you don't even fix. I don't care for your lame bot response, you're doing nothing."
            2. _Emma Smith_, 17.09.2026, 2/5: "After using this app for well over 10 years, I came back to it after a break, and you have to pay to do almost everything now which was always free, even to scan a barcode! Such a shame its turned into a money focused app... this uses to be the best app however, Im not sure it warrants the annual or monthly subscription - extremely disappointed."
            3. _Jason Ingraham_, 16.09.2026, 5/5: "canceled my trial subscription and they have tried charging my card 321 dollars. 4 times now."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.05.2026 - 18.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Amanda Rose_, 18.09.2026, 1/5: "the glitches on this app are unreal. The calories I enter will be correct, and the app will somehow calculate a completely different total number. My day will be 1400 calories, and it will show under total calories as 2200 or something silly. How do you mess up that bad when it's the entire point of your app?"
            2. _Jonathan_, 14.09.2026, 1/5: "I used it before and worked great but now I can't log my foods. when I try to add anything just freezes. I've uninstall and reinstall many times but everytime it freezes."
            3. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30.08.2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
<!--/ir-theme-->
